details: split_writes: orienting on op files
idea dynamic_split_reads: dynamic claiming of tile-row input sticks between NCRISC reader and BRISC writer

split_writes: NCRISC shadow-tracks cb_output_tiles tiles_received (never pops), writes tiles owned by ((r+cg)*S)%P<S, flushes, pushes token in new cb_write_done(8); writer issues the rest, waits token, pops. All NCRISC waits become polling loops that serve writes (deadlock-free).

Protocol: shared L1 words R (reader: seq,front,OPEN/ACK/CLOSED) in cb6 page and W (writer: seq,back,ENTER/CLAIM/DONE) in cb7 page; writer polls only while waiting for output, ENTERs a row, reader ACKs (then waits DONE) or CLOSEs (writer abandons); row 0 pre-ACKed (writer idle, taps blocking). Claims gated by outstanding-read window per RISC (NIU RD_RESP counter). Duplicates at the meeting chunk benign (both land before push).
